summary: Cartesian Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Loan and Security Agreement for up to $150M in senior secured term loans from K2 HealthVentures and other lenders, with $50M funded at closing. No special-situation event occurred; this is a routine debt financing for working capital, not an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing notes variable interest and optional conversion of up to $15M principal into stock, but lacks any triggering special-situation transaction.
